handoffs.message: Governed Trade Journey action admission is anchored at 800b37ea8; 30 focused/regression tests pass. Please review no-bypass dispatch, receipt/readback, RBAC, stale/idempotency/live-gate semantics, and decide whether production dispatcher composition is required before approval.

Changes requested: POST .../actions stale-revision guard compares request.expected_revision against materializer.revision (event-store-wide counter) instead of the per-journey revision the client actually reads back from list/detail responses (snapshot.get('revision')). Reproduced: in a store with >1 journey the two diverge immediately, so the guard will 409 legitimate non-stale actions. Fix: compare against the journey's own snapshot revision and add a multi-journey regression test. No-bypass dispatch, receipt/readback, RBAC (as wired in main.py), idempotency, and live-gate semantics all check out. Full findings: docs/reviews/2026-07-12-tj-e2e-008-claude-review.md (commit b836514d9).

Reviewer finding fixed in 915bbddb4: expected_revision now compares the target journey snapshot revision; multi-journey regression proves unrelated events do not cause false 409s. Verification: 31 passed, 4 warnings; git diff --check passed.
Approved: stale-revision guard fix (915bbddb4) confirmed against multi-journey regression; 31 passed, 4 warnings. Owner must finalize to done.
